verdict.rationale: Lovable documents a first-party Lovable MCP server that lets an external AI agent create projects, send messages to Lovable, inspect code, and deploy apps from the user's own client, so the server axis applies and the core story is delivered. Separately, published Lovable apps can be turned into MCP servers for ChatGPT, Claude, and other assistants, with configurable tools, sign-in, and permissions. Missing for 10: setup details for the Lovable MCP server (auth, transport, tool list), and independent or hands-on corroboration that it works.
